description: Sweep every item a price book's supplier can make and generate the sourcing profiles that make them quotable — the bulk version of upsert_item_sourcing_profile. For each candidate item it runs the deterministic pre-fill over the item's own custom field values; items whose every cost driver resolves get a profile created or updated, and the rest come back as gap rows naming the attribute that blocked them. RUNS AS A PREVIEW BY DEFAULT: the report is also the 'is my catalog priceable?' coverage diagnostic, so a bare call writes nothing and the coverage section ranks attributes by how many items they block. To actually write, pass dryRun=false, which requires the governed two-step: preview=true returns the report plus a single-use previewReceipt, then repeat with that receipt and a fresh idempotencyKey to commit. Writing is refused for a draft or archived book (a draft's attribute keys can still move, which would strand every spec saved now); previewing one is allowed and is the best way to see what activating it would make priceable. No AI is used — per-item AI inference stays one at a time.

applyDefaultSupplier.description: When true and profiles are created, sets each item's DefaultSupplierId to the book's supplier so the vendor link and sourcing profile stay in sync. Default false.

bookId.description: The price book id (GUID) to sweep.

clientId.description: Optional 3PL client id (GUID) — sweeps ALL items for this client regardless of supplier linkage. Breaks the chicken-and-egg where items need a vendor link before they can get a profile.

dryRun.description: Preview only. TRUE BY DEFAULT: the sweep reports what it would create/update/skip and writes nothing. Pass false to write, which requires the governed two-step below.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

maxItems.description: Optional cap on items evaluated in one sweep. A larger candidate set is reported as truncated (candidateCount vs scanned), never silently sampled.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write (only with dryRun=false): set true to resolve the sweep and receive the full report plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing is written until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

title: Generate Price Book Profiles
